lesson: When two functions contain identical lookup tables, changing one without the other is guaranteed drift. Either consolidate into one table or add a CI check that compares them.
evidence: spawn.rs line 39-51 vs cg_campaign.rs line 283-289 — stale base HP values went undetected by tests

lesson: Test assertions for numeric tuning must be tight enough to catch the bug they're meant to prevent. A loosely-bounded assertion (health > 40.0) was too loose to detect a 30% HP deficit.
evidence: cg_mission1_encounter.rs line 64 — passed even with wrong base HP
